name: Tektronix MSO64 Mixed Signal Oscilloscope
description: 4 GHz bandwidth mixed signal oscilloscope for RF signal debugging, protocol decoding, and PCB bring-up. Ideal for SPI, I2C, UART debug and high-speed digital signal analysis.
